content: The fastest animal on land is the cheetah, which can reach speeds of up to 75 miles per hour. In the air, the peregrine falcon is the fastest animal, reaching speeds of over 240 miles per hour while diving to catch prey. In the water, the sailfish is considered the fastest swimmer, reaching speeds of up to 68 miles per hour.
